title: Pip Finds Nell in the Rain Tub
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ch as k/sh, ow as oa.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ch as k/sh, ow as oa.

pages.text: Nell lands on the rim of the rain tub.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee landing on the curved wooden rim of a tall rain barrel.

pages.text: Nell slips and drops into the tub.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee tumbling down into the dark water inside the rain barrel.

pages.text: Nell buzzes, but Pip can not see her.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping past the tall barrel, unable to see inside it.

pages.text: Pip stops. Pip can hear a buzz.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pausing beside the rain barrel, head tilted, listening.

pages.text: Pip hops up on the rim.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping up onto the wooden rim of the rain barrel.

pages.text: Pip spots Nell in the water.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking down and spotting Nell the bee struggling in the water below.

pages.text: Pip gets a long stem from the grass.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow picking up a long, thin plant stem from the grass nearby.

pages.text: Pip lets the stem down into the tub.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow lowering the stem down into the rain barrel toward Nell.

pages.text: Nell grips the stem and gets up out of the tub.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee gripping the stem tightly and climbing up it out of the water.

pages.text: Nell is wet, but glad Pip was near.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee standing on the rim beside Pip, damp but smiling with relief.
